propositions: The code-review-verify spec emits only {verifications: [...]} output with no FAIL verdict or decision polarity, causing _verdict_decision to always map it to advisory regardless of gold label.
V-real-defect cases with gold label block are guaranteed recall misses because both arms score them as advisory, understating bedrock true recall.
Treating non-empty verifications as block would fix the recall miss but simultaneously mis-score V-clean-rename (gold advisory) as block, creating a false accept.
code-review-verify must be excluded from the parity corpus by a named polarity-free exclusion mechanism distinct from the existing AGENTIC_SOLVERS exclusion.
Exclusion reduces n_gold from 28 to 26 (still above MIN_GOLD_ITEMS floor of 20) and raises recall on both arms without changing gating verdicts.
